en: A black and white postcard image depicting a European street with historical buildings. The focus is on a prominent stone staircase leading up to an entryway with a distinctive bulbous canopy, typical of German or Central European Renaissance architecture. Wrought iron gates, ornate stonework, and a street sign reading 'Theater-Str.' are visible. There are also business signs, one marked 'Hotel', and a clock, indicative of a central urban area. The style of clothing and general street scene suggest an early 20th-century setting.
